critic.fix_suggestion: Apply a translation and rotation transform to the engine geometry to merge it with the wing structure. Specifically, move the engine's local origin along the X-axis (longitudinal) by 15% of its length toward the fuselage, and rotate it -2 degrees on the Y-axis (pitch) to align with the wing's leading edge angle. Adjust the Z-axis position so that the bottom face of the engine intersects the top surface of the wing at a 0mm gap, ensuring no visible void exists between the two primitive groups.

discrepancies.observed: Engines are floating away from the wing surface with visible gaps.
discrepancies.reference: Engines are flush-mounted and integrated into the wing structure.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move engines inward to intersect/merge with wing geometry.

discrepancies.observed: Landing gear struts are detached from the fuselage and wings, floating in space.
discrepancies.reference: Struts are physically connected to the underside of the fuselage and wing roots.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move landing gear bases to intersect with fuselage/wing bottom surfaces.

discrepancies.observed: The vertical stabilizer is detached from the rear fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The tail fin is seamlessly joined to the aft section of the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move and align tail fin base to merge with rear fuselage geometry.

discrepancies.observed: Wings appear as separate floating objects rather than continuous extensions of the body.
discrepancies.reference: Wings emerge smoothly from the lower side of the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Shift wing origins to intersect with the fuselage sides.
